headword: {金融引|きんゆうひ}き{締|し}め
gloss: monetary tightening; a policy of raising interest rates or restricting the money supply to curb inflation

definitions.gloss: monetary tightening; a policy of raising interest rates or restricting the money supply to curb inflation
definitions.explanation: Used in economic and financial reporting.

examples.japanese: {金融引|きんゆうひ}き{締|し}めが{続|つづ}いている。
{中央銀行|ちゅうおうぎんこう}は{金融引|きんゆうひ}き{締|し}めに{転|てん}じた。
examples.english: The central bank shifted to monetary tightening.

examples.japanese: {急激|きゅうげき}な{金融引|きんゆうひ}き{締|し}めは{景気後退|けいきこうたい}を{招|まね}く{恐|おそ}れがある。
examples.english: Rapid monetary tightening risks causing a recession.

notes:
A compound of {金融|きんゆう} (finance/monetary) and {引き締|ひきし}め (tightening). Refers to central bank policies aimed at reducing the money supply or raising interest rates to control inflation and cool down an overheating economy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金融引|きんゆうひ}き{締|し}めに{転|てん}じる: to shift to tightening
- {金融引|きんゆうひ}き{締|し}め{政策|せいさく}: tightening policy
- {金融引|きんゆうひ}き{締|し}めの{影響|えいきょう}: effects of tightening
- {段階的|だんかいてき}な{金融引|きんゆうひ}き{締|し}め: gradual tightening

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}: monetary easing (the opposite policy)
- {利上|りあ}げ: interest rate hike (a specific tightening tool)
- {量的引き締|りょうてきひきし}め: quantitative tightening
